title: KNOWN_UPDATE_KEYS has no test — drift silent when new patchable Contact field added
description: contact.rs: const KNOWN_UPDATE_KEYS = &["displayName", "blocked"]. The comment says this list must stay in sync with ChatContact's patchable fields in kith-store. There is no test that verifies KNOWN_UPDATE_KEYS is complete. When a contributor adds a new patchable field and forgets to update this list, the field silently returns invalidProperties at runtime. A test that patches each member of KNOWN_UPDATE_KEYS and asserts it is not in notUpdated would catch this at CI time.
